rules.description: Child must be under 16, or under 20 if in approved education or training
rules.reason_if_failed: Child maintenance can only be claimed for children under 16, or under 20 if they are in approved education or training

rules.description: Both parents must live in the UK
rules.reason_if_failed: The Child Maintenance Service can only be used if both parents live in the UK

rules.description: Parents must not be living together
rules.reason_if_failed: Child maintenance is only for parents who do not live together

rules.description: Must not have a child maintenance court order made less than 12 months ago, unless both parents agree
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot use CMS if you have a recent court order for child maintenance unless both parents agree to switch

rules.description: Parents must be unable to agree on a private arrangement
rules.reason_if_failed: Consider making a family-based arrangement first. CMS is for when parents cannot agree privately.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is experiencing or has experienced domestic abuse
edge_cases.action: Expedite application. Do not contact other parent without safety measures. Waive application fee. Provide domestic abuse support information.

edge_cases.description: Paying parent lives outside the UK but has assets or income in the UK
edge_cases.action: Route to international child maintenance team for reciprocal arrangement assessment.

edge_cases.description: Paying parent has significant expenses that should reduce the payment amount
edge_cases.action: Assessment must consider: costs of keeping in regular contact with child, costs for children living with paying parent, boarding school fees, mortgage/rent/council tax on former family home.

edge_cases.description: Child spends at least 52 nights per year with paying parent
edge_cases.action: Payment calculation must account for shared care nights. Reduction applies based on number of nights.

edge_cases.description: Paying parent has no income or income below threshold
edge_cases.action: Flat rate payment of £7 per week applies if on certain benefits. Nil rate if in prison, care home, or aged 16-17.
